contact.evidence_quote: My name is Kimberly Scamman ... I moved to Maine more than 35 years ago from sunny Arizona, and today I’m grateful to call a small lake in Southern Maine home, where I live with my husband. For over 25 years, I’ve been a licensed nail technician dedicated to providing thoughtful, attentive, and personalized nail care.
